# Tamrakar Complex - Tech Marketplace Nepal

> A Nepal-focused product discovery, independent-store marketplace, price-reference, and gadget service platform.

Tamrakar Complex helps users discover products, compare Nepal market price references, contact independent stores, and request gadget services. A catalog price is not a guaranteed offer unless the product page identifies the seller, stock, final price, and purchase path.

## Core Features

- [Marketplace](https://tamrakarcomplex.com/marketplace): Browse and sell used or new gadgets with ease.
- [Mobile Prices](https://tamrakarcomplex.com/cat/mobiles): Phone catalog and Nepal market price references.
- [Repair Hub](https://tamrakarcomplex.com/repair): Professional repair services with tracking for smartphones and laptops.
- [Valuation Estimator](https://tamrakarcomplex.com/valuation-estimator): Get an instant AI-powered price estimate for your old phone.
- [Store Directory](https://tamrakarcomplex.com/stores): Find and contact listed tech stores in Tamrakar Complex.
- [Marketplace Disclosure](https://tamrakarcomplex.com/marketplace-disclosure): Seller identity and reference-price explanation.
- [Shipping & Delivery](https://tamrakarcomplex.com/shipping-delivery): Delivery and pickup terms.
- [Returns & Refunds](https://tamrakarcomplex.com/returns-refunds): Seller-specific return and dispute information.

## For Store Owners

- [Store Registration](https://tamrakarcomplex.com/auth): Join the platform to list products and reach thousands of customers.

## Technical Details

- [Sitemap](https://tamrakarcomplex.com/sitemap.xml): Full site structure for indexing.
- [Robots.txt](https://tamrakarcomplex.com/robots.txt): Crawler and AI bot configuration.
